mapper.select: SELECT candidate.* FROM ai_runtime_publish_task candidate WHERE ((candidate.status = 'PENDING' AND candidate.next_attempt_at_ms <= #{nowMs}) OR (candidate.status = 'PROCESSING' AND candidate.lease_until_ms < #{nowMs})) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_runtime_publish_task older WHERE older.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND (older.data_id <=> candidate.data_id OR older.data_id IS NULL OR candidate.data_id IS NULL) AND (older.group_name <=> candidate.group_name OR older.group_name IS NULL OR candidate.group_name IS NULL) AND older.seq < candidate.seq AND older.status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') ) ORDER BY candidate.seq ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_runtime_publish_task candidate LEFT JOIN ai_runtime_publish_task older ON older.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND (older.data_id <=> candidate.data_id OR older.data_id IS NULL OR candidate.data_id IS NULL) AND (older.group_name <=> candidate.group_name OR older.group_name IS NULL OR candidate.group_name IS NULL) AND older.seq < candidate.seq AND older.status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') SET candidate.status = 'PROCESSING', candidate.lease_owner = #{owner}, candidate.lease_until_ms = #{leaseUntilMs}, candidate.updated_at_ms = #{nowMs} WHERE candidate.id = #{id} AND ((candidate.status = 'PENDING' AND candidate.next_attempt_at_ms <= #{nowMs}) OR (candidate.status = 'PROCESSING' AND candidate.lease_until_ms < #{nowMs})) AND older.id IS NULL

UPDATE ai_runtime_publish_task candidate LEFT JOIN ai_runtime_publish_task newer ON newer.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND (newer.data_id <=> candidate.data_id OR newer.data_id IS NULL OR candidate.data_id IS NULL) AND (newer.group_name <=> candidate.group_name OR newer.group_name IS NULL OR candidate.group_name IS NULL) AND newer.seq > candidate.seq SET candidate.status = CASE WHEN newer.id IS NULL THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'SUPERSEDED' END, candidate.attempts = candidate.attempts + 1, candidate.next_attempt_at_ms = 0, candidate.lease_owner = NULL, candidate.lease_until_ms = 0, candidate.last_error = #{error}, candidate.updated_at_ms = #{nowMs} WHERE candidate.id = #{id} AND candidate.status = 'PROCESSING' AND candidate.lease_owner = #{owner} AND candidate.lease_until_ms >= #{nowMs}

UPDATE ai_runtime_publish_task candidate LEFT JOIN ai_runtime_publish_task newer ON newer.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND (newer.data_id <=> candidate.data_id OR newer.data_id IS NULL OR candidate.data_id IS NULL) AND (newer.group_name <=> candidate.group_name OR newer.group_name IS NULL OR candidate.group_name IS NULL) AND newer.seq > candidate.seq SET candidate.status = 'PENDING', candidate.gate_status = 'PENDING', candidate.gate_eval_run_ids_json = NULL, candidate.gate_decision_json = NULL, candidate.gate_evaluated_at_ms = NULL, candidate.next_attempt_at_ms = #{nowMs}, candidate.lease_owner = NULL, candidate.lease_until_ms = 0, candidate.last_error = NULL, candidate.updated_at_ms = #{nowMs} WHERE candidate.id = #{id} AND candidate.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND candidate.status = 'BLOCKED' AND candidate.gate_status = 'BLOCKED' AND newer.id IS NULL

UPDATE ai_runtime_publish_task candidate LEFT JOIN ai_runtime_publish_task newer ON newer.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND (newer.data_id <=> candidate.data_id OR newer.data_id IS NULL OR candidate.data_id IS NULL) AND (newer.group_name <=> candidate.group_name OR newer.group_name IS NULL OR candidate.group_name IS NULL) AND newer.seq > candidate.seq SET candidate.status = 'PENDING', candidate.gate_status = 'OVERRIDDEN', candidate.gate_override_id = #{overrideId}, candidate.next_attempt_at_ms = #{nowMs}, candidate.lease_owner = NULL, candidate.lease_until_ms = 0, candidate.last_error = NULL, candidate.updated_at_ms = #{nowMs} WHERE candidate.id = #{id} AND candidate.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND candidate.status = 'BLOCKED' AND candidate.gate_status = 'BLOCKED' AND newer.id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_runtime_publish_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND revision = #{revision} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
